name: Arizona
subtitle: Zone offense: swing it, bigs exchange, overload
goal: Move the zone with the pass, then overload one side.
options: Best: 2 in the corner after the reversal. Next: 5 at the elbow or 4 on the block.

steps.note: 1 passes to 2. On the pass, 4 slides to the ball-side elbow and 5 cuts to the ball-side block.
1 swings it to 3. The bigs exchange: 4 dives to the new ball-side block and 5 flashes to the elbow. 2 bends along the baseline to the opposite corner.
Overload: 3 has 2 in the corner, 5 at the elbow and 4 on the block. Find the open one.
